setting: You both live in a rented flat in Brunswick, Melbourne, and have been together for about two years after meeting through friends at a trivia night. You know each other's families, habits, and food preferences well, and you both know the other has been wanting a proper holiday together for a while. The last thing you chatted about in this group was whether the bins were going out on Thursday.
opener: Ask Daniel whether he'd rather go to the coast or the mountains for the trip.

Mia.knows: You know Daniel is your partner of two years, that he's a careful planner who likes a plan on paper, and that he gets anxious when travel days run late.
Mia.like: You're easygoing and organised, with a dry sense of humour that people sometimes miss. You have firm opinions about good food and about never paying for checked bags.
Mia.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when something needs deciding, rather than just to chat.
Mia.style: You type with normal capitals and punctuation and use an emoji now and then.

Daniel.knows: You know Mia is your partner of two years, that she's relaxed about plans in the moment and good at finding the best option quickly, and that she's been pushing for a trip somewhere warm.
Daniel.like: You're thoughtful and a little anxious about big decisions, with a gentle sense of humour that comes out in the small things. You have strong views on public transport and on the proper way to read a map.
Daniel.texts: You message in this chat only occasionally, usually to reply or confirm something, and rarely start a conversation.
Daniel.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation and rarely use emoji.

private_lines.Mia: You work as a UX designer for a software company in the city and usually go in three days a week, working from home the rest. You live with Daniel in a two-bedroom flat, and your days are busy but predictable: a run before work, meetings, dinner together, and a show or a book in the evenings.
private_lines.Daniel: You teach secondary school science at a state school in the northern suburbs, so you're at work from early morning until mid-afternoon and marking most evenings. You live with Mia in Brunswick, and your weekdays are structured around school, with weekends slower and spent cooking or walking with Mia.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text: ok so coast or mountains for the trip. which do you actually want, not which one you think I want
I'm fine either way but I'd rather not spend four days arguing about it
Sorry, just got through the first pile of year 9 reports. Coast, I think. Warm, and I can read on a beach without feeling like I should be doing something.
Though the mountains would mean walking, which I'd like
you can walk on the coast
there's a whole cliff walk thing around jervis bay, you'd like it
How far is it from Melbourne by car? I'm not doing a long drive with you complaining the whole way
I'm not complaining, I'm narrating
google says like 9 hrs. ok scratch that
flights then. sunshine coast is an hour and a bit from brisbane. or cairns if you want reef
Flights mean the airport at 5am and you know how I get about that.
i know. you'd be fine. we'd get the 6:10 and I'd have you sorted with a coffee and a plan on paper
and we're not paying for checked bags so you can stop thinking about that too
I wasn't thinking about the bags
I was thinking about the bags
ok flights. sunshine coast or the reef side. don't say both
Sorry, marking. Sunshine Coast. It's warm, it's close enough to the reef if you want it, and I can plan the drive from Brisbane properly.
you can plan whatever you like. I'll pick a place to stay
you still want mountains btw? honest answer
Not really. I wanted walking. We can walk on the coast.
👍 yes
the neighbours had their bins out again on tuesday. tuesday. who does that
Ours are going out tomorrow night, I'll do it before I start marking. Is it still Thursday for the recycling?
yes
the green one is thursday, the yellow one is every second week. I've put it on the fridge calendar
i'll look at the 6:10 flights tomorrow, send me any dates you want to avoid
Yes. Send me the times when you have them.
ok found some. 6:10 tullamarine to brisbane, dec 11. back dec 15 the 4:40pm one
the 6:10 is the only one that doesn't make us change in sydney
Dec 11 is fine. Not the 15th, the 15th is report moderation at school and I'll be useless
Back the 14th or 16th?
16th the 9:15 is better. 14th is 6am, I'm not doing 6am twice
Fine. 16th
coffee machine on 4 is broken again. I'm not drinking the one on 2 I already know it's bad
Daniel you'd have opinions about this
Lunch. I have opinions about everything today, sorry
Which hotel are you looking at? You said you'd pick a place
noosa or maroochydore. maroochydore is cheaper and closer to the airport but noosa has the better beach walk, which is the whole point
i'll show you tonight, there are like 4 options and one has a pool that looks like a photo
Mocked a whole class of 9s about the difference between weight and mass. Still got three of them wrong on the test.
Bins are out. Did them at 15:30 before I got home so I'm not doing it at 11pm, I'll be marking
wait its tuesday, the bins arent till wednesday
They're out now. I'm not moving them back
ok maroochydore. the one with the pool. $212 a night, free cancellation until the 4th
i've held it, dont make me regret it
Holding is fine. Did you book it or just hold it?
And I checked the other one, the reviews say the pool is closed in December for cleaning. Check that before we commit
Mia, did you book it or just hold it? Sorry, I know you're asleep
held, not booked. it's free till the 4th so we've got time. I'll check the pool thing first
Good. Don't book until the pool is confirmed. Ask them in writing.
And please don't "just hold it" for the next week either
emailed them already. they say the pool is open all december, reviews are from last year's clean
Put their reply in here when it comes so I can see it.
🙄 ok
coffee on 2 is as bad as I said. I've made peace with it
Lunch. Is the carry-on limit 7kg? My big blue bag is not going under 7kg.
it's 7kg and they do weigh them sometimes. get a backpack
I'm not getting a backpack.
😂 ok take the blue one and I'll stand at the scale with you
hotel replied. pool open the whole stay, they'll tell us 7 days ahead if anything closes. forwarding to you now
Good. Ask them to confirm the room is on the pool side too.
daniel
asking
Got the reports back in on time for once. One of my 9s asked if the sun has weight. I said in a sense, yes, and now I've made it worse.
😂 tell him it's still a valid question
booked. $212 x 4 nights, free cancel till the 4th still. confirmation's in your email
Thank you. I'll check the dates are right.
they're right
I know. I'll check anyway.
Did they confirm the pool-side room?
yes. "pool view" which is a bit vague but they said it was the pool side
How do we get from the airport to the hotel? I've looked at the bus timetable and it's a mess.
uber. it's 20 mins. you're allowed to not have a plan for one thing
I have a plan for the bus.
ok the bus
neighbours' bins out AGAIN. it's wednesday. they're doing it on purpose
Ours are in. Green's tomorrow night, I'll do it before I start marking.
ok 👍
